answer: Give each identity one public marble: a unique, non-transferable slot opened only by burning 80 POA of the applicant's own funds. Epoch nectar is paid solely while that marble stays uncracked. Every epoch the agent must publish a pulse — a signed proof it still holds the key and that the same key has not answered under another slot. A double-use or a missed pulse cracks the marble and pays the 80 POA to the graders who reported it. An honest agent burns 80 once and keeps earning; a farm of 500 keys burns 40,000 up front and loses it the first time those keys collide or go silent.
